# Tracker Views

Create and verify three baseline views: Ready to work (`Ready` and `In
progress`, sorted by Priority), By release (including unscheduled work), and
Initiatives (top-level items without a parent). Add other views only for a
recurring need. An accepted filter matching nothing is a configuration
failure, not an empty backlog.
